gap:logistic_regression_task.statement: Need to fit logistic regression models on data.json with specific conventions: 5-fold contiguous CV, full-batch GD (200 iterations, lr=0.1), L2 regularization search, interaction term analysis, and model compression evaluation.

hyp:l2_regularization_improves_generaliz.statement: Moderate L2 regularization (lambda in [0.01, 0.1]) will reduce Brier score compared to unregularized model (lambda=0).

hyp:interaction_terms_beneficial.statement: Interaction terms (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) may improve model fit with paired t-test t-stat > 2.0.

claim:l2_optimal_lambda.statement: Lambda=0.1 achieves the lowest 5-fold cross-validated Brier score (0.207077) among tested values [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0], providing 0.0089 improvement over the unregularized baseline.

claim:interaction_beneficial.statement: Interaction terms (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly reduce Brier score: paired t-test yields t-stat=3.912 (p=0.017), exceeding threshold of 2.0. Interaction model improves upon raw features across all 5 folds.

claim:compression_best_config.statement: Among 6 compression configurations (3 sparsity × 2 bits levels), sparsity20_bits4 retains 99.92% of dense model Brier performance, making it the optimal compression strategy.
